newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Gunmen fire on Somali Islamic leader, one killed.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen fire on Somali Islamic leader, one killed.

text.p: At least one person was killed and four were wounded in the Somali capital when unknown gunmen opened fire on a prominent Islamic leader and his armed escort, witnesses said on Tuesday.
All the victims were civilians, caught in crossfire on Monday at a road junction in North Mogadishu, where fighting raged for 45 minutes between Sheikh Ali Dhere's bodyguards and the attackers.
The reason for the fighting was unclear. Clan elders were meeting on Tuesday to discuss the violence.
Relations between Dhere and North Mogadishu faction leader Ali Mahdi Mohammed have been tense since October when Dhere was dismissed as chairman of the supreme Islamic court.
Mogadishu residents were shocked by the fighting which broke out as they were celebrating the end of the Moslem holy month of Ramadan.
Somalia has had no government since the overthrow of late dictator Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991.
